none: PAS NLM-F7C916: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from fridaythorpe
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-33, Reece period 17, probably Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them, pyramid tops to standards. Reverse inscription: GLOR [IA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: pellet followed by P. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.55gms, die axis: 6
